meta.purpose: DDx reasoning benchmark — consolidated. Scores ranked differentials against expert labels.
meta.status: CLINICIAN-RATIFIED v1.0 — cannot-miss dimension fully ratified (8 label corrections + synonyms, ledger 12-Jul-2026). expectedLanes + documentedNegatives/unsupportedCannotMiss labels still pending for the null metrics.
notes: acceptableTopDx: any-of, normalized-substring match (see per-case synonyms).
mandatoryCannotMiss: must appear ANYWHERE in the returned differential.
cases with mandatoryCannotMiss=[] are deliberate benign/specificity tests (top-1/top-3 + over-flag), not cannot-miss.

freeze-time corrections (V-ratified, 12-Jul-2026): (1) D11 — dropped the 'CES' synonym; the 3-char token substring-hit 'abs(CES)s', collapsing the two distinct cannot-miss dx. Canonical 'cauda equina syndrome' + 'cauda equina' retained. (2) cannot_miss_bearing corrected 51->50 (D59 reclassified to incomplete/appropriate-uncertainty; carries no mandatoryCannotMiss). Matcher stays frozen at ddx-eval/2; a general short-token word-boundary guard is logged as a Matcher v3 follow-up.
